status: Mappings accepted by the user (October 9, 2026; notes still say 'REVIEW' where a judgement was made, see logs/_b12_xwalk_review.txt). Phase 7C (October 16, user decisions): Alberta electricity is modelled as wires + Rate of Last Resort pairs (section 'pairs'); optional time-of-use/time-of-day and peak-event products outside Ontario are excluded from the medians; Ontario/Alberta gas stays excluded until Phase 7D; PUC Distribution maps through the generic Ontario rules. October 16 (7C-2): periods of block thresholds published in bare kWh moved to data/models/block_periods.json; 'required_contributors' withholds the Newfoundland and Labrador residential model while Newfoundland Power is not computable (user decision). November 24 (method 7T-1, owner decisions 64-75): the territories are modelled for residential and small commercial non-government classes; government classes are excluded (government_rate), the joint Yukon rate book counts once (shared_rate_books) and interim rates are labelled (interim_rates).
scope: Latest record per (utility_name, name, customer_class) by effective_date, as the site dedupes, with provenance 'live'. Provinces and, since 2026-11-24, the territories (first release: residential and small commercial; territory_planned_later marks territorial classes left for a later release).

matching.order: First matching rule wins; utility-specific rules precede generic ones; territories last.
matching.province: Two-letter code or null (any); the model province is the rule's, else the record's.
matching.fuel: 'electricity' | 'gas' | null, compared with the record's utility_type.
matching.match: All listed criteria must hold: tariff_code (exact), tariff_code_regex and name_regex (Python re.fullmatch on the whole string; also written with ^...$), customer_class, rate_structure.
matching.outcome: Exactly one of model {sector, structure, size_band} or exclude (reason from vocabulary.exclusions).
matching.adding_utilities: Append utility-specific rules before the territory rules and, within a province, before that province's generic ('*') rules; an empty match ({}) covers every record of the utility. Records with no rule are reported as unmapped by `python -m pipeline.representative_models --coverage`.

sectors.residential: Household service (single-family and individually metered dwellings).
sectors.commercial: Non-residential general service (commercial, institutional and building-related general facility service), banded by size; Ontario Large Use maps to commercial_xlarge.

structures.flat: One energy price (plus fixed charges); no demand charge, blocks or time periods.
structures.tiered: Energy price varies by consumption block (inclining or declining), no demand charge.
structures.tou: Clock-based time-of-use energy prices (including flat rates with time-of-day adjustments).
structures.tiered_tou: Tiered energy plus clock-based time-of-day adjustments (BC Hydro 1101 + 2101).
structures.ulo: Ontario RPP Ultra-Low Overnight time-of-use plan.
structures.critical_peak: Peak-event pricing: utility-called event hours priced high, other hours lower.
structures.seasonal: Energy price varies only by season (reserved; unused).
structures.demand: Billed on peak demand (kW or kVA) plus energy (flat, blocked or seasonal).
structures.demand_tou: Demand billing with time-of-use energy or demand periods (reserved; unused).
structures.interruptible: Standard published interruptible service class with its own prices.

exclusions.pilot: Pilot or experimental schedule with limited or closed enrollment.
exclusions.optional_product: Optional add-on layered on a base tariff (green power, RNG blends, rentals, optional programs), not a standard rate.
exclusions.adjustment_or_rider_only: Rider, credit or adjustment applied to another tariff; no standalone price.
exclusions.conditional_only: Eligibility needs specific equipment (dual-energy, thermal storage), a load-factor or usage-pattern condition, or customer-specific assets; not the default class.
exclusions.off_grid_or_diesel: Isolated diesel/off-grid electricity or isolated propane systems.
exclusions.process_or_non_building: Process or non-building service (farm, irrigation, oil field, unmetered loads).
exclusions.generation_or_net_metering: Generation credits, net metering, self-generation or renewable access.
exclusions.standby: Standby or capacity reservation for self-generating customers.
exclusions.interruptible_special: Curtailable/interruptible credit option modifying another class.
exclusions.reference_only: Reference only (e.g. a schedule for one named customer).
exclusions.market_reference_only: Wholesale market reference record with no customer tariff (AESO pool price); never a customer model.
exclusions.territory_planned_later: Reworded Nov 24 (owner decision 75): territorial class left for a later territorial release; the first release models residential and small commercial (under 50 kW) non-government classes.
exclusions.government_rate: Added Nov 24 (owner decision 71): government account class (federal, territorial or municipal government, including Qulliq's municipal tax-based commercial class); it stays in the Rate Browser but out of the medians, which model non-government customers.
exclusions.delivery_only_alternative: Delivery- or transportation-only variant with marketer/retailer commodity at a private price, duplicating a full-service model.
exclusions.duplicate_variant: Another record of the same utility already represents this service (same-class branch, elective alternative for the same customers, special multi-unit classification).
exclusions.industrial_use_only: Added Oct 9: eligibility limited to industrial (manufacturing/processing/extraction) use; the general-service class represents the band.
exclusions.supply_voltage_alternative: Added Oct 9: class defined by supply voltage/pressure (transmission, sub-transmission, primary, mainline) or customer-owned transformation, an alternative to the standard class for the same load.
exclusions.residential_large_demand: Added Oct 9: residential service billed on demand for >= 50 kW residences; outside the residential usage levels, no residential demand model.
exclusions.service_fees: Added Oct 9: schedule of service fees, not a rate.
exclusions.province_not_modelled_yet_7c: Added Oct 9 (batch 12), unused since Phase 7C (October 16): Alberta electricity record (distribution/transmission wires or Rate of Last Resort energy) before Alberta wires + Rate of Last Resort pairs were modelled.
exclusions.paired_retail_component: Added Oct 16 (Phase 7C): Alberta Rate of Last Resort energy record, priced only as the retail half of a wires + Rate of Last Resort pair (section 'pairs'); not a standalone model.
exclusions.no_reference_level: Added Nov 19 (batch 18 continued): the class's printed eligibility (phase, demand or consumption range) fits none of the reference usage levels (Lethbridge 992 and 995).
exclusions.eligibility_unpublished: Added Nov 19 (batch 18 continued): the class's size limits are not published in the utility's sources, so a usage level cannot be assigned without assuming them (Medicine Hat 3.1 and 3.3, owner decision 2026-11-19).
exclusions.gas_models_phase_7d: Added Oct 9 (batch 12); reworded Nov 23 (method 7D-2): natural gas class outside the Phase 7D models (contract-demand, interruptible, seasonal, peaking and large-volume load-factor services). Residential and commercial general service are modelled; these classes are left out until their own owner decision (decision 4, 2026-11-20).

zones.default: Standard/default zone or service area. Ontario: tariff code without zone suffix (Hydro One R1, GSe, GSd). Elsewhere: main interconnected, urban or mainland service.
zones.other: Another standard rate zone or location-assigned class of the same utility (Ontario '-<ZONE>' code suffix / '[zone]' name; Hydro One UR/R2/AR/AUR, UGe/AGSe/AUGe, UGd/AGSd/AUGd; rural, Labrador, Fort Nelson). Use is an engine option pending the user's choice: default zones only, or each multi-zone utility once as the median of its zones.

commercial_xlarge.label: >= 5,000 kW
commercial_xlarge.note: Reference 5,000 kW is the band floor, used only for band assignment; no usage level is defined yet.

size_band_rules: Electricity size_band is a list: a record contributes to each listed band (each utility counts once per band).

'@demand_bounds' = computed from demand_min_kw/demand_max_kw as [min, max): every band whose reference_kw lies in the range; if none, the band that contains the range; if none, every overlapping band. Used for Ontario demand classes, e.g. GS 50-4,999 kW -> medium + large, GS 50-999 kW -> medium, Large Use -> xlarge.
Elsewhere bands are set per rule from published eligibility; kVA limits use the 0.9 power factor in usage_levels.json (for example 110 kVA = 99 kW, 1,000 kVA = 900 kW).

Per usage level the engine uses only records whose eligibility covers that level's kW ([min, max), or the published inclusivity of a reviewed demand_bounds entry, e.g. FortisBC Electric Rate 20 'not more than 40 kW') and kWh (e.g. NSPower Rate 10 below 32,000 kWh/yr), then combines that utility's zones per the zone policy.

Gas size_band (method 7D-2, owner decision 2026-11-20): the building-size bands commercial_small and commercial_medium (gas_size_bands). Every general-service class of a utility lists both bands; at each level the engine uses the class whose reviewed usage_bounds (annual volume = 12 x the level, or Liberty's monthly peak) contain it, so a utility's classes share one model and each utility counts once.

commercial_small.label: small building
commercial_small.note: Small commercial or institutional building: levels 1,000 m³ (500, 2,000) and 30 GJ (15, 60) a month, usage_levels.json gas.commercial_small.

commercial_medium.label: mid-size building
commercial_medium.note: Mid-size commercial or institutional building: levels 5,000 m³ (2,500, 10,000) and 200 GJ (100, 400) a month, usage_levels.json gas.commercial_medium.

pairs.basis: Phase 7C (user decision, October 16, 2026): Alberta all-in units pair a wires utility with the Rate of Last Resort (RoLR) provider for its area. The wires record's rule in 'rules' gives the model key; 'classes' names the RoLR record (tariff_code) billed with each wires class. Each unit counts once, like one utility; every component keeps its own source and dates; the composite record id is '<wires id>+<retail id>'. A wires class without a RoLR record, or whose RoLR record is not live, is not computable at the RoLR levels (reason listed).
pairs.retail_rule: Rate of Last Resort energy applies only below 250,000 kWh a year (12 x the level's monthly kWh): the residential levels and both small-commercial levels. At larger levels the wires record is used alone and energy is market-priced (Alberta pool price through a retailer), so the model is market_energy_pending until Phase 6C.

market_energy.component_name: Energy at market prices through a retailer (Alberta pool price; pending Phase 6C)
market_energy.market_reference: AESO pool price (Alberta wholesale market; Phase 6C)
market_energy.note: Sites using 250,000 kWh a year or more are not eligible for the Rate of Last Resort; their energy follows the Alberta pool price and is not modelled yet (Phase 6C).

pairs.method_note: Alberta service areas: each wires utility is paired with the Rate of Last Resort provider for its area (ENMAX Power + ENMAX Energy Corporation in Calgary; ATCO Electric + Direct Energy Regulated Services; EPCOR Distribution + EPCOR Energy Alberta in the EPCOR Distribution area; FortisAlberta + EPCOR Energy Alberta in the FortisAlberta area); each service area counts once and every component keeps its own source and dates. The cities of Lethbridge and Red Deer publish both their distribution tariff and their area's Rate of Last Resort, and the City of Medicine Hat's bundled rate covers its delivery charges and its own default energy price, so each city is one service area. Rate of Last Resort energy (price fixed to December 31, 2026) applies only below 250,000 kWh a year; at larger levels the wires charges are used alone and energy is pending (Alberta pool price, Phase 6C). Direct Energy Regulated Services' daily administration charge is not included (its current value is published without an effective date). EPCOR Distribution's 2026 rates are interim (medium confidence).
